g.text: 1. 会合で短い金利の方針を決める

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 2. A の国債を買い、代金を当座預金に入れる

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 吸い上げるときは逆に債券を売る

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 3. 余った預け金を翌営業日返しで貸しに出る

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 4. 貸し手が増え、前より低い金利で借りる

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 短い金利が方針の水準に近づく
